name: KOOPEO Ventures
decision_note: Brno/Prague investment company of a private group that invests only its own money (CZK 3-15m tickets) in CEE startups such as Localazy, Realpad and Kardi AI, and joined Trifft Loyalty's pre-seed round in July 2025 - an active private investor, not a pooled VC fund.

evidence.quote: KOOPEO Ventures je investiční společnost zaměřená na venture capital a private equity projekty v rámci regionu CEE.

Zpravidla investujeme v rozmezí 3 až 15 milionů korun, do projektů s vysokým potenciálem růstu, hlavně v oblastech internetu, mobilních aplikací, cloudových služeb, e-commerce, affiliate marketingu a moderních technologií.
We only invests our own money which allows us to make investment decisions very quickly.

Trifft Loyalty uzavřel tzv. preseed kolo (počáteční fáze života startupu) ve výši 410 tisíc liber (11,6 milionu korun), které vedli čeští investoři Lighthouse Ventures za účasti BD Partners, Gi21 Capital a Koopeo.
Portfolio investovaných projektů AIffinity Localazy Kardi AI Senzoor Realpad

analyst_notes: Second-pass screen. Type: self-described 'investiční společnost' for VC and PE projects (e1); its investor profile says it invests only its own money (e3, self-reported); the site shows a group with 'Společností ve skupině' and '1 miliarda Kč v aktivech' (group-level figure, not a fund - not recorded as capital); directories place it in the WASA group. Treated as private_investor with own capital (consistent with Miton, Gi21 Capital), so S1. If the coordinator decides own-capital startup investors with a dedicated team count as vc, this is an include candidate: Czech offices (Brno seat, Praha, Bratislava), Czech portfolio (Localazy, Realpad, Kardi AI) and a dated in-window deal (Trifft Loyalty pre-seed, Seznam Zprávy 2025-07-30, led by Lighthouse Ventures; Caplight dates it July 2025). Ticket: the approach page gives CZK 3-15m 'zpravidla' while its banner shows 0.5-15 mil. Kč; the profile says up to EUR 500k. Stage taken from the self-reported profile (pre-seed and seed). Sector mapping: internet/cloud/mobile apps -> software_saas; e-commerce/affiliate -> ecommerce_marketplaces/consumer. Trifft Loyalty is Czech-British; company_country left null. Statutory body (ARES VR): Vladimír Šťastný, Petr Špaček, Libor Daněk.
